about: Your questions for the ablation (at least three), written before you run it. Each has an id, the question as the person in DESIGN.md section 1 would ask it, and the right answer: what a correct answer must say, and where you checked it in the data. 'env' is set for every run (paths from the repository root). 'max_steps' is the most model turns a run may take.

questions.question: Is any work reported on Busch Blvd near USF (28.0587, -82.4139) right now, and which lanes are closed?
questions.answer: Yes: one work by the City of Tampa on East Busch Boulevard, about 2 mi from the point, reported as 2 records, until Thu Nov 5 at 4:00 pm. Eastbound, the right lane of 3 travel lanes is closed (the feed lists it as lane 4 of 5, because it counts the shoulders). The other record gives no direction and no lane impact. Checked in snapshots/2026-11-05/fldot.json, work 4577091647.

questions.question: Does the sewer work on 30th St near USF (28.0587, -82.4139) close any lanes?
questions.answer: The feed does not say: every record of the 30th St works reports its lane impact as unknown. That is not the same as no lanes closed. Checked in snapshots/2026-11-05/fldot.json: vehicle_impact is 'unknown' on all 4 records.
